methodology.warning: Ranks cannot identify actual poverty incidence. Differences here are scenario assumptions informed by a development ranking, not district poverty measurements. Spending or GDP is not used as a poverty rate.

profiles.method: ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIO PROXY, not a measured or statistically validated district poverty rate. rawFactor=0.5+(SEGE2022rank-1)/(districtCount-1); rate=0.13*rawFactor/populationWeightedMean(rawFactor). SEGE is a broad development index, not a poverty measure. Calibration uses the reported national 2025 50%-median relative-poverty benchmark; its income reference is 2024. ADNKS population includes institutional residents unlike the income-survey universe. No household income/rent model or uncertainty interval has been estimated.
